in_marathi.name: Chandrakiran
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandrakiran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandrakiran means 'Moon Crystal'. This name is derived from Chandrama, the Sanskrit word for moon, and kiran, meaning ray or crystal. In Hindu mythology, the moon is believed to be the source of all life and sustenance, making Chandrakiran an auspicious name for a baby boy.
